program.name: Bell Week
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: A balanced week with one kettlebell: bell strength, then a Tabata or bouts, then a flow or core.
program.about: A balanced week built on one kettlebell. Each day lifts the bell first, then either a Tabata of swings and jumps followed by a mobility flow, or shadowboxing bouts followed by a kettlebell core circuit. Strength, conditioning and recovery in every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Bell lift, bell Tabata & flow / bell lift, bouts & bell core
